content:
New patrons, old politics. With the BJP now in power in West Bengal, several prominent Durga Pujas in Kolkata have seen TMC leaders replaced by BJP politicians as patrons.

The new patrons promise to return the festival to local communities, but questions remain over political influence, religious traditions and artistic freedom.

Written by: Atri Mitra, Adrija Roychowdhury

Read: https://lnkd.in/gPjxCNeY
comment: The real test is whether community committees retain control over budgets, themes and artist selection. Changing political patrons means little if creative decisions remain tied to political loyalty.
